name: Magical Deep☆One
original_name: マジカルディープ☆ワン
source:
Princess Ruri arrives from an overseas magical country to train into being a good ruler. If she can help five people with their troubles by using magic, she can become the queen. The protagonist Kyouji who is a high school student agrees to help the princess in exchange for fulfilling one wish if the training goes well.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-april-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
